{% raw %}
`reboot`: restart the computer.

## Synopsis

<strong>reboot</strong>

## Description

<strong>reboot</strong> ends every process, closing their files (so what they wrote reaches the disks), and restarts the computer: it goes off and on again, and the EEPROM boots afresh. It takes no arguments.

## Exit status

It does not return when it works. If the kernel refuses, the reason is printed and the status is 1.

## See also

<strong>poweroff</strong>(1), <strong>halt</strong>(1)
